scope: AI outputs are based solely on publicly available information.
AI cannot access non-public databases, private archives, or paid content.
AI cannot verify the authenticity or accuracy of user-provided materials.
AI cannot detect statistical bias or sampling errors in source data.
AI cannot guarantee completeness of academic or historical sources.
uncertainty: All conclusions contain inherent uncertainty due to incomplete information.
Historical, social, and psychological interpretations may vary across scholars.
Predictions are scenario-based and not deterministic.
Correlations do not imply causation unless explicitly supported by high-tier evidence.
risk: AI cannot foresee black-swan events or extreme unpredictable risks.
Policy changes, geopolitical shifts, and market disruptions may invalidate conclusions.
User-specific contextual factors may significantly alter applicability.
disclaimer: Outputs are for reference only and do not constitute professional advice.
Users should consult licensed professionals for medical, legal, or financial decisions.
